blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly used as automated judges for image-editing benchmarks, yet their reliability is poorly understood. Auditing these judges is difficult because real edited images lack controlled ground truth and entangle the requested changes with model artefacts, unintended side effects, and ambiguous degrees of success. In this paper, we introduce EditJudge-Bench, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,382 synthetic before/after image pairs rendered in Blender, with edits parameterised across nine categories derived from real user requests and exact ground truth from known 3D scene parameters. Because every edit is generated by a known intervention on a controlled scene, EditJudge-Bench evaluates VLM judges as binary verifiers of whether an instruction was correctly executed, isolating judge perception from editor quality. Across 25 judge configurations, we find substantial reliability gaps: (a) the widely adopted VIEScore template reaches only 69.0% AUROC with GPT-4o; (b) fine-tuned judges score 51.7-66.3%; spatial edits such as rotation and shape remain challenging; (c) prompt-formatting choices like image-text ordering shift performance by up to 14.1 points. Despite using only synthetic data, judge rankings on EditJudge-Bench correlate strongly with two real-image human-preference benchmarks ($ρ$=0.95 and $ρ$=0.71), indicating that controlled audits surface failure modes relevant to real evaluation.
blocks.zh: 愿景语言模型(VLMs)被越来越多地用作图像编辑基准的自动判断器,然而其可靠性却不甚为被理解. 审计这些判断很困难,因为真实的被编辑的图像缺乏可控的地面真相并用模型工艺、意外的副作用和模棱两可的成功程度来纠缠所要求的变化。 在本文中,我们介绍了Edit Judge-Bench,这是Blender所渲染的1,382个图像成对之前/之后合成的诊断基准,其编辑参数分为9个类别,分别取自真实用户的要求和从已知的3D场景参数得出的准确的地面真相. 由于每一次编辑都是由一个被控制的场景上已知的干预产生的,Edit Judge-Bench评价VLM评委是二进制验证员,以判断某一指令是否被正确执行,将法官的认知与编辑质量相隔离. 在25个法官配置中,我们发现存在很大的可靠性差距:(a) 广泛采用的VIEScore模板与GPT-4o相比只达到69.0%的AUROC;(b) 微调的法官得分为51.7%-66.3%;旋转和形状等空间编辑仍然具有挑战性;(c) 快速格式化的选择,如图像文本命令转换性能最高可达14.1分。 尽管只使用合成数据,法官在Edition Judge-Bench上的排名与两个实际形象的人优基准(美元=0.95美元和美元=0.71美元)密切相关,表明控制下的审计表面故障模式与实际评价有关。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Instruction-based image editing systems can now modify scenes, swap objects, and adjust visual attributes from natural-language prompts [ 3 , 38 , 54 ] . As these systems become more capable, reliable evaluation becomes increasingly important. Human evaluation remains the gold standard, but it is expensive, slow, and difficult to reproduce. Consequently, many benchmarks use Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as automated judges [ 18 , 24 , 49 , 33 , 27 ] , making VLM scores part of the default evaluations.
blocks.zh: 基于指令的图像编辑系统现在可以修改场景,交换对象,并从自然语言的提示来调整视觉属性[3,38,54]. 随着这些系统的能力提高,可靠的评价变得越来越重要。 人的评价仍然是金本位,但价格昂贵,速度缓慢,难以再生. 因此,许多基准使用Vision-Langage Models(VLMs)作为自动化裁判[18,24,49,33,27],使得VLM评分成为默认评价的一部分.

blocks.en: This reliance raises a fundamental question: can these judges reliably verify the edits they are asked to score? Existing validation protocols typically measure correlation with human preferences over a fixed pool of editing-model outputs. Such correlation is useful, but indirect. A judge may agree with humans on average by detecting broad image quality, salient artifacts, or obvious semantic changes, while still failing to perceive precise edits such as rotation, shape change, subtle attribute shift, or whether a preservation constraint was satisfied.
blocks.zh: 这种依赖性提出了一个根本性的问题:这些法官能否可靠地核实他们被要求作分的编辑? 现有的验证协议一般衡量与人类偏好相对于固定的编辑-模型输出集合的相关性. 这种关联是有用的,但间接的。 法官可以通过检测出广义的图像质量,显著的文物,或明显的语义变化,同时仍无法感知到诸如旋转,形状变化,微妙的属性转变等精确的编辑,或是否满足了保存限制,从而平均地与人类一致.

blocks.en: Examining this failure mode is challenging because real editing-model outputs lack controlled ground truth. The requested edit is entangled with model-specific artefacts, unintended modifications, and ambiguous degrees of success. If a judge assigns a poor score, it is often unclear whether the judge failed, the edit request was ambiguous, or the edited image was genuinely flawed. This ambiguity is especially problematic because edit evaluation requires visual differencing across two images, grounding the observed change in the instruction, and detecting unintended changes to preserved content. VLMs already struggle with spatial reasoning and fine-grained visual discrimination in single images [ 43 ] ; therefore, before/after edit evaluation may expose even sharper limitations.
blocks.zh: 检查这种失败模式具有挑战性,因为真正的编辑模型输出缺乏可控的地面真伪. 所请求的编辑与特定模型的手工艺品、意想不到的修改和模棱两可的成功程度纠缠在一起。 如果法官分配得分差,往往不清楚法官失败,编辑请求模糊不清,或者编辑后的形象确实存在缺陷. 这种模糊性尤其有问题,因为编辑评价需要在两个图像之间产生视觉差异,将观察到的指令变化打下基础,并检测出为了保存内容而意想不到的改变. VLM已经与空间推理和精细的图像视觉歧视相抗衡 [43];因此,编辑评价之前/之后可能暴露出更尖锐的限制.

blocks.en: To isolate these factors, we need diagnostic benchmarks in which the intended edit, its magnitude, and the preserved content are known exactly. We therefore introduce EditJudge-Bench , a controlled benchmark for auditing VLM-based image-editing judges. EditJudge-Bench contains 1,382 synthetic before/after image pairs rendered in Blender, with parameterised edits spanning nine edit types and exact ground truth from 3D scene parameters. Because EditJudge-Bench audits judges rather than ranking editors, it uses controlled synthetic edits and binary ground-truth correctness labels. These labels are not intended to replace holistic human judgments of edit quality; instead, they provide targeted probes of whether a judge can distinguish instruction-consistent from instruction-inconsistent changes. For example, given the instruction “rotate the chair to the left,” a factual pair contains the requested rotation, while a counterfactual pair changes an irrelevant property. This construction separates judge failures from the ambiguities of real editing-model outputs.
blocks.zh: 为了孤立这些因素,我们需要诊断性基准,在这种基准中,预定的编辑、其规模和所保存的内容是完全清楚的。 因此,我们采用了Edit-Judge-Bench,这是审计基于VLM的图像编辑法官的控制基准。 编辑Judge-Bench 包含 Blender 所渲染的图像对前后所合成的1 382个,其中参数化编辑跨越了9个编辑类型,以及3D场景参数中准确的地面真实性. 因为"编辑"(Edit Judge-Bench)的审计法官而不是排名编辑,它使用受控的合成编辑和二进制地-真实正确性标签. 这些标签并不是要取代编辑质量的人类整体判断;相反,它们提供了目标明确的探查,以确定法官是否能够区分指令与指令不一致的变化。 例如,鉴于指示“将椅子旋转到左边”,一个事实对包含要求的旋转,而一个反事实对则改变一个无关的财产。 这一构件将判定失败与实际编辑-模型产出的模糊性分开。

blocks.en: Our experiments reveal substantial reliability gaps in current evaluation methods. The widely used VIEScore template [ 18 ] achieves only 69.0% AUROC with GPT-4o, while fine-tuned judge models range from 51.7% to 66.3% AUROC. Prompt-formatting choices can shift performance by up to 14.1 points, and several judges exhibit systematic blind spots for spatial edits, and tend to miss small or low-salience changes when verifying instructions. Surprisingly, a simple log-probability baseline outperforms several complex zero-shot and fine-tuned judge protocols. To validate that audits on synthetic data are informative for real-image evaluation, we further show that judge rankings on EditJudge-Bench correlate strongly ( ρ \rho =0.95) with rankings on GenAI-Bench [ 12 ] , a human-preference benchmark over real edited images.
blocks.zh: 我们的试验表明,目前的评价方法存在很大的可靠性差距。 被广泛使用的VIEScore模板[18]在GPT-4o上只实现了69.0%的AUROC,而精细的判事模型从51.7%到66.3%的AUROC. 即时格式化选择可以使性能变化达14.1分,多位法官为空间编辑显示系统性的盲点,在验证指令时往往会错过小或低亮的变化. 出人意料的是,一个简单的对数概率基线的表现超过了几个复杂的零发和微调判事协议. 为了证实对合成数据的审计为真实图像评价提供了信息,我们进一步表明,法官在编辑法官-Bench上的排名与GenAI-Bench[12]上的排名密切相关,而GenAI-Bench上的排名是人优于真实编辑图像的基准。

blocks.en: Our contributions are:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:

blocks.en: 1. We introduce EditJudge-Bench , a diagnostic benchmark of 1,382 controlled before/after image pairs rendered in Blender, with exact ground truth from 3D scene parameters and an edit taxonomy derived from real user requests. 2. We present a procedural generation pipeline for constructing factual and counterfactual edit triplets whose correctness is known by construction, enabling controlled audits of VLM-based image-editing judges. 3. We show that widely used VLM judges are substantially less reliable than their adoption suggests: VIEScore with GPT-4o reaches only 69.0% AUROC, fine-tuned judges range from 51.7% to 66.3%, and prompt-formatting choices can shift performance by up to 14.1 points. 4. We identify systematic judge failure modes, including weak visual differencing, spatial blind spots, and salience bias on subtle edits, and find that a simple log-probability baseline outperforms several more complex zero-shot and fine-tuned judge protocols.

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Image editing models. Early approaches operated on paired training data [ 11 ] or required per-image optimization [ 15 ] . Instruction-based editing removed the need for manual masks or paired examples [ 3 , 38 , 54 ] , enabling users to specify edits in natural language. Recent systems extend this to an increasingly diverse set of edit types, including spatial rearrangement, appearance and style transfer, geometric transformation, lighting adjustment, and compositional changes [ 56 , 51 ] . As the space of supported edits has grown, so has the need for evaluation methods that can assess whether each edit was performed correctly. This growing diversity makes aggregate evaluation scores increasingly difficult to interpret: a metric that is reliable for appearance edits may still fail on spatial, geometric, or magnitude-sensitive edits.
blocks.zh: 图像编辑模型. 早期方法在配对培训数据上运行 [11] 或按需要对每个图像进行优化[15]. 基于指令的编辑取消了手动口罩或配对示例[3,38,54]的需要,使用户能够以自然语言指定编辑. 最近的系统将它扩展到日益多样化的一套编辑类型,包括空间重排、外观和样式转移、几何转换、照明调整和组成变化[56、51]。 随着所支持的编辑空间的扩大,评估方法的必要性也随之增加,可以评估每个编辑是否正确进行. 这种日益增长的多样性使得总体评价分数越来越难以解释:对于外观编辑来说,一个可靠的度量标准在空间,几何,或对大小敏感的编辑上仍然可能失败.

blocks.en: Evaluation of image editing. Some benchmarks compare model outputs against ground-truth references obtained from editing models [ 54 , 51 ] or human annotators [ 41 ] , but image editing is a one-to-many task where a single reference is inherently restrictive, and the references themselves inherit the biases of their source. Model-generated references share the failure modes of the generators, while human references vary in quality and lack diversity across edit types. Reference-free CLIP-based metrics [ 35 ] avoid this issue [ 3 , 38 , 56 , 2 ] . However, their global embeddings behave like bag-of-words representations and perform poorly on spatial and compositional reasoning [ 17 , 52 ] , making them unsuited for localised edit assessment. These limitations motivated the use of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as judges. VIEScore [ 18 ] introduces prompt templates for semantic consistency and perceptual quality, and recent state-of-the-art benchmarks routinely evaluate edits with VLM-as-a-judge [ 47 , 24 , 41 , 26 , 44 ] . Some approaches fine-tune smaller models to replicate larger ones [ 49 , 26 ] , while others train dedicated reward models on human preferences [ 34 , 46 , 26 ] or combine VLMs with specialist perceptual models [ 45 , 40 , 33 ] . Benchmarks have also grown more fine-grained, moving from uniform metrics across all edit types [ 54 , 56 ] to specialised scoring dimensions [ 40 , 45 ] and targeted evaluation of specific capabilities such as motion alignment [ 44 ] , knowledge plausibility [ 47 ] , and spatial reasoning [ 57 ] . These works improve how image editing models are evaluated, but they generally do not isolate whether the VLM judge itself can perceive each instructed edit under controlled ground truth. Our work is complementary: rather than proposing another metric for ranking image editors, we evaluate whether VLM judges can reliably verify controlled edits with known ground truth.
blocks.zh: 图像编辑评价. 一些基准将模型产出与从编辑模型[54,51]或人类注释者[41]获得的地上真实参考进行比较,但图像编辑是一项一对一的任务,其中单一参考具有固有的限制性,参考本身继承了来源的偏见. 模型生成的参考文献共享生成器的故障模式,而人类的参考文献质量各有不同,在编辑类型上缺乏多样性. 无参考的基于CLIP的衡量标准[35]避免这一问题[3,38,56,2]. 然而,他们的全球嵌入表现像"袋字"的表达,在空间和构成推理[17,52]上表现不佳,使其不适合本地化的编辑评估. 这些限制促使人们使用远景语言模型作为法官。 ViEScore [18] 引入了语义一致性和知觉质量的即时模板,最近的最新最新基准定期用VLM-as-a-judge[47、24、41、26、44]评价编辑情况。 一些方法对较小的模型进行微调以复制较大的模型[49,26],而另一些方法则在人类偏好上培训专门的奖励模型[34,46,26],或者将VLM与专家的认知模型相结合[45,40,33]. 基准也变得更加精细,从所有编辑类型[54、56]的统一度量标准转向专门评分维度[40、45],并有针对性地评价具体能力,如运动相配[44]、知识的可信度[47]和空间推理[57]。 这些作品改进了图像编辑模型的评价方式,但一般不会孤立VLM法官本身是否能够在被控制的地真下感知到每个被指示的编辑. 我们的工作是相辅相成的:我们不是为图像编辑的排名提出另一个衡量标准,而是评价VLM法官是否能够可靠地用已知的地面真相来验证控制的编辑.

blocks.en: Limitations of VLM judges. Using language models as judges is well-established for text evaluation [ 58 , 8 , 19 ] , but extending it to vision introduces challenges that text does not face. VLMs exhibit systematic perceptual shortcomings. They inherit visual encoder blind spots that cause failures on basic patterns such as orientation, counting, and spatial relationships [ 43 , 9 , 36 ] , and they hallucinate object properties and spatial configurations even when the visual evidence is unambiguous [ 22 , 10 ] . Existing validation of VLM editing judges typically compares judge scores with human preferences over outputs from a fixed set of editing models [ 12 , 46 , 26 ] . This tests aggregate agreement on a particular output distribution, but it does not test perceptual correctness. A judge can correlate with humans while failing to identify whether the requested object moved, changed shape, or preserved irrelevant content. This limitation is amplified when the same small set of editing models defines the preference pool. If those models share artefacts or failure modes, a judge may learn cues associated with model quality rather than the instructed visual change itself. Even dedicated reward models trained on hundreds of thousands of preference pairs [ 46 ] share this limitation. The same editing models appear in both training and evaluation, so generalisation beyond those distributions remains untested. A further concern is reproducibility: many benchmarks rely on proprietary judges whose model snapshots are updated or deprecated over time, making reported scores difficult to regenerate [ 6 , 32 ] . For text-only LLM judges, diagnostic benchmarks with objective correctness labels already exist [ 42 , 53 ] . Benchmarks such as MLLM-as-a-Judge [ 5 ] , MJ-Bench [ 7 ] , and Multimodal RewardBench [ 48 ] evaluate VLM judges on general vision-language tasks and text-to-image generation, but do not target before/after edit verification. For VLM edit judges, EditInspector [ 50 ] relies on crowdsourced labels over diffusion-edited images, entangling instruction verification with synthesis artefacts and annotator subjectivity. EditJudge-Bench instead derives ground truth from the underlying 3D scene intervention rather than post-hoc human judgement.
blocks.zh: 志愿LM法官的限制。 使用语文模式作为法官对于文本评价[58、8、19]是公认的,但将其扩大到愿景则带来了文本没有遇到的挑战。 自愿终止措施显示出系统性的认知缺陷。 他们继承了视觉编码盲点,这些盲点在诸如取向,计数,和空间关系等基本模式上造成故障[43,9,36],即使视觉证据是明确的[22,10],他们也会幻觉出物体属性和空间配置. 对VLM编辑法官的现有验证通常将法官的分数与一组固定编辑模型中的人对产出的偏好进行比较[12,46,26]. 这种测试对特定输出分布的聚合协议,但并不测试知觉正确性. 法官可以与人类相关联,同时无法识别被请求的物体是否移动、改变形状或保存无关的内容。 当同一套小的编辑模型定义了偏好池时,这一限制被放大. 如果这些模型共享手工艺品或故障模式,法官可以学习与模型质量相关的提示,而不是指示的视觉变化本身。 即使是经过数十万对优先对象培训的专用奖励模式[46]也有这种限制。 同样的编辑模式在培训和评价中都出现,因此,除了这些分发内容之外,还没有得到测试。 另一个关切是可再生性:许多基准依赖专有法官,其模型快照随时间推移而更新或贬值,使得所报告的分数难以再生[6,32]. 对于只使用文字的LLM判断,已经存在带有客观正确性标签的诊断基准[42,53]. 诸如MLLM-as-a-Judge [5],MJ-Bench [7],和Multimodule Reward Bench [48]等基准评价VLM法官的一般视觉语言任务和文本到图像生成,但在编辑核实之前/之后不设定目标. 对于VLM编辑评委,"编辑"(Edition Inspector [50])依靠众包式标签而不是传播-编辑的图像,将指令校验用合成工艺品和注释取材. 编辑法官Bench 取而代之的是基础 3D场景干预 而不是人类事后判断

blocks.en: Synthetic datasets are a standard tool for evaluating vision systems where real-world ground truth is impractical to obtain. For judge auditing, this control is especially valuable because it separates evaluator errors from ambiguity or artefacts in the edited image. Rendered scenes with known properties enable diagnostic evaluation with controlled ground truth, as demonstrated across visual reasoning [ 14 ] , optical flow [ 4 , 28 ] , long-term point tracking [ 59 ] , and inverse rendering [ 23 ] . This principle has also been applied to image difference captioning [ 30 , 25 , 16 ] . CLEVR-Change [ 30 ] and OmniDiff [ 25 ] generate synthetic before/after pairs to benchmark models that describe visual changes. However, these datasets target describing what has changed and not scoring whether an instructed edit was correctly performed. Moreover, their scene complexity and change taxonomies do not align with the edit categories of modern models. Our benchmark fills this gap by using Blender-rendered image pairs with exact ground-truth changes to evaluate VLM judges on specific edit types expected of modern models. OBJect [ 29 ] is most similar in design, rendering procedural Blender scenes for translation, rotation, insertion, and removal edits, though it trains and evaluates editing models rather than auditing judges.
blocks.zh: 合成数据集是评价现实世界地面真相不切实际的视觉系统的标准工具. 对于法官审计来说,这种控制特别有价值,因为它将评估员的错误与编辑的图像中的模棱两可或手工艺品区分开来。 具有已知特性的渲染场景可以使诊断性评价具有可控地面真理,这表现在视觉推理[14],光学流[4,28],长期点跟踪[59],反向渲染[23]. 这一原则也适用于图像差异标题[30、25、16]。 CLEVR-Change [30]和OmniDiff [25] 生成对前/后合成,用于描述视觉变化的基准模型. 然而,这些数据集目标描述了已经发生的变化,没有评分指示编辑是否正确进行. 此外,它们的场景复杂性和变化分类与现代模型的编辑类别不一致. 我们的基准通过使用Blender的图像配对和准确的地上事实变化来评估对现代模型预期的特定编辑类型进行的VLM判断来填补这一空白. OBJect [29] 在设计,渲染程序方面最相似 Blender的场景用于翻译,旋转,插入和去除编辑,尽管它训练和评价编辑模型而不是审计法官.

blocks.en:
Auditing a judge requires ground truth that is independent of the systems being judged. When an editing model generates an output, the result entangles the instructed change with model-specific artifacts and hallucinations, imprecise geometry, or unintended side effects.
This makes it impossible to isolate what the judge actually perceives.
We sidestep this by generating before/after pairs entirely in Blender [ 1 ] , where every edit is a deterministic parameter change in a known 3D scene. Unlike existing editing pipelines, this allows us to guarantee that (i) the edit is exactly what the instruction describes, and (ii) everything outside the edit is identical, eliminating confounds. We first derive an edit taxonomy grounded in real user requests (Sec. 3.1 ), then assemble diverse 3D scene assets (Sec. 3.2 ), and generate edits procedurally with rejection sampling (Sec. 3.3 ). Finally, we construct the final benchmark with factual and counterfactual instructions.
blocks.zh:
审计法官需要独立于所判断系统的基础真相。 当编辑模型产生出出一出出,结果将指示变化与模型特有的文物和幻觉相缠绕,不精确的几何,或者意外的副作用.
这使得无法孤立法官的实际看法。
我们通过完全在 Blender [1] 中生成前后对子来绕开它,其中每次编辑都是已知3D场景中决定性的参数变化. 与现有的编辑管道不同,这使我们能够保证:(一) 编辑完全如指令所描述的,(二) 编辑之外的一切都是相同的,消除了困惑. 我们首先根据真实的用户请求(Sec. 3.1)得出编辑分类法,然后组装不同的3D场景资产(Sec. 3.2),然后用拒绝抽样程序生成编辑(Sec. 3.3). 最后,我们用事实和反事实指示构建最终基准。

blocks.en: 3.1 Edit taxonomy
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 编辑分类

blocks.en:
Existing benchmarks define their own ad hoc set of edit categories, ranging from a handful of types in MagicBrush [ 54 ] to twenty in AnyEdit [ 51 ] , making cross-comparison difficult and leaving gaps in coverage.
We instead derive a bottom-up taxonomy from 42,400 real-world editing requests collected from the Reddit community r/PhotoshopRequest via the RealEdit dataset [ 41 ] . Using diversity-aware sampling, hierarchical clustering, and LLM-based instruction decomposition (see Appendix C ), we identify recurring atomic operations and group them into 20 edit action attributes.
We distil these into 9 canonical edit types covering the operations that can be faithfully implemented in our procedural pipeline.
These edit types can be categorised into object-level edits (Removal/Addition, Movement, Rotation, Scale, Shape, Articulation, Material) and scene-level edits (Lighting, Camera Position and Zooming).
blocks.zh:
现有的基准定义了自己临时的一组编辑类别,从MagicBrush[54]到AnyEdit [51]的20个类型,使得交叉比较变得困难并留下了覆盖的空白.
我们从Reddit社区 r/Photoshop Request通过RealEdit数据集收集的42 400个真实世界编辑请求中得出一个自下而上的分类。 我们利用多样性意识取样、分层分组和基于LLM的指令分解(见附录C),确定经常性原子操作,并将其分组为20个编辑动作属性。
我们把这些分解成9个条形文字编辑类型, 涵盖可在我们程序过程中忠实执行的操作。
这些编辑类型可以被分类为对象级编辑(Removal/Addition, Movement, Rotation, Scale, Shape, Articulation, Material)和场景级编辑(Lighting,相机位置和缩放).

blocks.en: Edit types and saved scene parameters. Fig. 2 illustrates the edit operations supported by EditJudge-Bench . Each edit is generated by intervening on a known Blender scene parameter, shown in the centre of the figure. Object-level edits modify a single target object, while scene-level edits modify global rendering or camera parameters. Movement changes the object position 𝐱 \mathbf{x} on its supporting surface, with direction quantised into eight camera-relative directions. Rotation changes the object orientation 𝐫 \mathbf{r} around the vertical axis. Scale applies a uniform change to object scale 𝐬 \mathbf{s} with collision checking. Shape modifies a continuous procedural shape parameter θ \theta , such as chair back height or table thickness. Articulation modifies a joint parameter ψ \psi , such as opening or closing a door. Material changes the material assignment m m , either for the full object or for a semantically meaningful material slot, such as an oven body or glass panel. Removal changes object visibility v v by hiding a visible object; Addition is obtained by swapping the before/after pair of a removal edit. Lighting changes the illumination state ℓ \ell by applying one of ten lighting presets. Camera edits modify the camera state 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , either by perturbing focal length for zoom edits or by re-sampling the camera pose on the viewing cylinder for view edits.
blocks.zh: 编辑类型并保存场景参数 。 图2说明了Edit-Judge-Bench支持的编辑操作。 每个编辑都是通过在已知的 Blender 场景参数上进行干涉生成的,显示在图的中心. 对象级编辑修改单个目标对象,而场景级编辑修改全局渲染或相机参数. 运动改变物体位置 x\ mathbf{x} 在其支持的表面, 方向被量化为八个相机相对的方向 。 旋转改变对象方向 r\ mathbf{r} 围绕垂直轴。 缩放对对象缩放 s\ mathbf{s} 进行相撞检查时应用统一更改 。 形状会修改一个连续的程序形状参数 \\theta , 如椅回高或桌厚等 。 拼写修改了联合参数\\\ psi,例如打开或关闭一扇门。 材料会改变材料分配m m, 或用于完整的物体, 或用于一个精密有意义的材料槽, 如烤箱体或玻璃面板。 删除对象能见度 v 通过隐藏可见对象; 添加是通过互换去除的一对前/后编辑来获得的. 照明通过应用十种照明预设之一来改变照明状态 I\ell. 相机编辑修改相机状态 C\ mathcal{C},或者通过扰动焦距来进行缩放编辑,或者通过在取景筒上重新取样相机外观来进行取景编辑.

blocks.en: All edit types use rejection sampling to enforce physical plausibility. Collision checks prevent interpenetration, visibility checks ensure that the edited content remains in view, and magnitude thresholds remove negligible changes. Crucially, every edit is produced by a known procedural intervention, and each example stores the ground-truth parameter values before and after the edit. We use these parameters later to audit whether VLM judges are sensitive to the semantic correctness of an edit or merely to the visual salience induced by the underlying parameter change.
blocks.zh: 所有编辑类型都使用拒绝抽样来强制实施物理可信度. 碰撞检查防止了互通,能见度检查确保了被编辑的内容保持视线,而星等阈值去除可忽略的改变. 关键是,每个编辑都是由已知的程序干预产生的,每个实例在编辑前后存储地-真实参数值. 我们稍后使用这些参数来审计VLM评委对编辑的语义正确性是否敏感,还是仅仅对基本参数变化引起的视觉突出性是否敏感.

blocks.en: Generation pool statistics. We render 5,284 edits across 1000 3D scenes, with balanced sampling across edit types, object classes, and scenes. Fig. 3 shows edit examples, and Fig. 4 shows per-type parameter distributions.
blocks.zh: 世代池统计. 我们做了5,284个编辑,覆盖了1000个三维场景,在编辑类型、对象类别和场景之间进行了均衡的取样。 图3显示编辑实例,图4显示每个类型的参数分布.

blocks.en: Counterfactual Distractors. A judge is unreliable if it can merely detect that something changed without understanding the edit. To test this ability, we generate four types of counterfactual instructions that should be answered negatively given the same image pair, each targeting a distinct failure mode. Directional: The core edit parameter is logically inverted (e.g., left to right, larger to smaller, opened to closed), testing whether the judge perceives the direction or state of the change. Wrong-Object: The edit description is retained, but the target object is replaced with a different visible object in the scene (e.g., “Move the table to the right” when the chair was moved), testing object grounding. Cross-Edit-Type: The instruction describes a different edit type with a visually confusable effect (e.g., camera zoom paired with object scaling), testing whether the judge identifies what kind of change occurred. No edit: The instruction specifies that nothing should be changed, testing open-ended visual differencing.
blocks.zh: 反事实干扰器。 法官不可靠,只要能发现某些东西在不理解编辑的情况下发生了改变。 为了测试这种能力,我们生成了四种类型的反事实指令,它们应该以相同的图像对来负回答,每种都针对一个截然不同的失败模式. 方向 : 核心编辑参数在逻辑上被倒置(例如从左到右,从大到更小,从打开到关闭),测试法官是否感知到变化的方向或状态. 错误对象:编辑描述被保留,但目标对象被取而代之的是场景中不同的可见对象(如"把椅子移到右边"),测试对象下地. 交叉编辑类型 : 指令描述了一种具有可视相容效应的不同编辑类型(如相机缩放与对象缩放对等),测试判断者是否识别发生了何种变化. 不编辑: 指令指定任何内容都不应更改, 测试开放式的视觉差异 。

blocks.en: EditJudge-Bench . For evaluation (Sec. 4 ), we subsample from the larger pool of 5,284 rendered edits to obtain balanced coverage across edit types, object classes, and scenes, and to keep evaluation cost across 25 judge configurations manageable. We obtain a balanced core benchmark of 1,500 source/edited image pairs, corresponding to 3,000 rendered images. Each image pair includes one factual instruction and a set of counterfactual distractors, producing 7,318 verification triplets in total: 1,500 factual and 5,818 counterfactual.
blocks.zh: 编辑法官本奇。 为了评价(第4节),我们从更大的5 284个集合中进行子抽样,进行编辑,以获得编辑类型、对象类和场景的均衡覆盖,并使25个法官配置的评价费用可以控制。 我们得到了1500个源/编辑成像对的平衡核心基准,相当于3000个成像. 每对图像包括一个事实指示和一组反事实分辨器,共产生7,318个可验证的三相:1,500个事实和5,818个反事实.

blocks.en: Manual curation. Procedural rendering occasionally produces pairs that cannot be verified reliably from the images alone. We therefore manually reviewed all 1,500 pairs and removed those where (i) the instruction text did not precisely match the rendered edit, or (ii) the change was too subtle to be reliably perceived. This removes 118 pairs (7.9%), yielding a curated subset of 1,382 pairs, on which we report all main results.
blocks.zh: 手作道场. 程序渲染偶尔会产生单从图像中无法可靠地验证的对子. 因此,我们手动审查了所有1 500对,并删除了(一) 指令文本与编辑内容不完全一致,或(二) 变化太微妙,无法可靠地察觉的内容。 这消除了118对(7.9%),产生了1,382对的编程子集,我们报告了所有主要结果。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Sampled edit parameter distributions. Each plot shows the distribution of parameters sampled during edit generation. Shape, articulation, and movement distributions are clipped at the 98th percentile for readability. Dashed lines mark no-change values for rotation and scale.
blocks.zh: 图4:样本编辑参数分布. 每块地圖会显示编辑生成过程中所取取的参数的分布. 形状,发音和运动分布在可读性第98分之一被剪接. 折叠行标记旋转和比例的不变值。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental results
blocks.zh: 4 实验结果.

blocks.en: Using EditJudge-Bench , we run controlled experiments with recent VLM judges to isolate individual factors affecting judge accuracy. We establish the evaluation task, validate data quality, and define the prominent VLM paradigms evaluated to establish baseline performance on our benchmark.
blocks.zh: 使用 Edit Judge-Bench, 我们用最近的 VLM 判官进行控制实验, 隔离影响法官准确性的个别因素。 我们确定评价任务,验证数据质量,并界定所评价的VLM突出范式,以建立基准业绩。

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol. We frame edit verification as a binary classification of an edit triplet: the source image, the edited image, and the text instruction. Positive triplets combine a source image, an edited image, and the corresponding factual instruction. Counterfactual triplets use the same source–edited image pair, but replace the factual instruction with an incorrect distractor described in Sec. 3.3 . We report AUROC over the binary labels and predicted continuous scores, measuring whether judges assign higher scores to factual triplets than to distractor triplets.
blocks.zh: 评估协议。 我们把编辑校正设定为编辑三进制的二进制分类:源图像,被编辑的图像,以及文本指令. 正三相结合了源图像,被编辑的图像,以及相应的事实指示. 反事实三重奏使用同源编辑成像对,但用Sec中描述的不正确的分心器来取而代之. 3.3 (英语). 我们报告AUROC在二进制标签和预测连续分数上,衡量法官是否给事实三重赛分配了比分散注意力三重赛更高的分数.

blocks.en: As a stricter complementary diagnostic, we additionally report MC-style forced-choice accuracy, which counts an example as correct when the judge assigns the unique highest score to the factual instruction among its matched counterfactual distractors. If the factual instruction ties for first among k k candidates, it receives 1 / k 1/k credit.
blocks.zh: 作为更严格的补充诊断,我们又报告MC式的强制选择精度,当法官在与之相匹配的反事实分心者中为事实指示分配独特的最高分时,这个精度就是一个正确的例子。 如果K考生之间的事实指示与K考生有关,则获得1克/克1/克的信贷。

blocks.en: 4.1 VLM-as-a-judge methods
blocks.zh: 4.1 VLM-as-a-judge的方法

blocks.en: To evaluate VLM-as-a-judge methods systematically, we group existing approaches into three scoring paradigms and evaluate representative models from each.
blocks.zh: 为了系统地评价作为法官的自愿结束活动方法,我们把现有方法分为三个评分模式,并评价每个模式的代表性模式。

blocks.en: Generative scoring instructs a base VLM to generate a numerical score conditioned on the edit triplet, as in VIE-score. Since our benchmark measures only edit correctness, we use only the correctness-related prompt of each protocol (e.g., semantic consistency in VIE-score, instruction following in KRIS) and omit separate quality prompts. Prior work often couples such templates to proprietary models like GPT-4o; to separate template effects from base-model effects, we evaluate the same templates across multiple base models.
blocks.zh: Generative 评分指示一个 Base VLM 生成一个以编辑三进制为条件的数字分数,如VIE-分数. 由于我们的基准度量只编辑正确性,因此我们只使用每个协议的正确性相关快取(例如:在VIE分数中语义一致性,在KRIS中遵循指令),并省略了单独的质量快取. 先前的工作常常将这样的模板与GPT-4o等专有模型相配;为了将模板效果从基准模型效果中分离出来,我们通过多个基准模型来评价相同的模板.

blocks.en: Probabilistic scoring uses the model’s next-token distribution rather than a sampled numerical response. We include a simple binary log-probability baseline, where the model is prompted to classify each triplet as True or False . We use the next-token probability assigned to True as a continuous correctness score. This pointwise scoring formulation is closely related to the inference mechanism of Qwen3-VL-Reranker [ 20 ] , which we also include for comparison.
blocks.zh: 概率评分使用该模型的下接子分布,而不是抽样的数字响应. 我们包含一个简单的二进制对数概率基准,其中该模型被激励将每个三进制分类为真或假. 我们使用True的下接概率作为连续正确度分. 这种分分法配方与Qune3-VL-Ranker [20] 的推论机制密切相关,我们也包括这个机制以供比较.

blocks.en: Supervised scoring uses models trained in prior work [ 49 , 46 , 26 ] using supervised fine-tuning or reinforcement learning to align edit-quality scores with human preferences.
blocks.zh: 监督评分使用在前作中经过训练的模型[49,46,26],利用监督的微调或强化学习,使编辑质量分数与人类偏好相配合.

blocks.en: 4.2 Main results
blocks.zh: 4.2 主要成果

blocks.en:
Table 1 reports AUROC across nine edit categories for 25 judge configurations grouped by scoring paradigm.
First, we observe that the widely adopted VIEScore template is unreliable for the model that popularised it. VIEScore was introduced with GPT-4o, where it reaches only 69.0% AUROC on EditJudge-Bench . Holding the template fixed, performance varies widely across base models (51.5 with Qwen3-VL 4B to 88.5 with GPT-5.6-sol), so a popular template does not by itself imply reliable verification. Only the latest frontier models (GPT-5.6-sol, 88.5; Opus 5, 83.5) are consistently strong judges. However benchmarks rely on older model versions that prove to be unreliable.
Second, open-source models with simple probabilistic scoring match or exceed earlier-generation proprietary models, though frontier models remain ahead. Holding the base model fixed, the scoring formulation matters substantially. Gemma-4 reaches 74.3 with VIEScore, 74.6 with ImgEdit prompting, and 81.0 with binary log-prob scoring, which is the best open-source result, above GPT-5.4 (77.9), GPT-4o and Gemini-2.5-flash. Probabilistic scoring is the strongest zero-shot formulation for every open-source backbone where we evaluate it. This indicates that mainstream zero-shot templates underutilise the underlying VLMs.
Third, supervised scoring judges trained on human preferences do not consistently transfer to factual verification. ImgEdit-Judge reaches 51.7% (i.e., near chance performance), EditScore 63.4%, and EditReward 66.3%. None outperforms simple log-prob scoring on its own base model (65.4 for Qwen3-VL 4B; 70.1 for Qwen2.5-VL 7B). Preference tuning evidently captures aggregate quality cues that do not generalise to whether the requested edit was executed.
Fourth, the performance is uneven across edit categories. Removal (98.8% best) and material (90.1%, reached by open-source Gemma-4 with log-prob scoring) are detected reliably, while geometric and spatial edits remain weak: even the best judge reaches only 83.0 on shape and 80.1 on rotation, and no open-source configuration exceeds 62.5 on shape or 63.8 on rotation.

blocks.en: To validate that our synthetic edits are perceptually unambiguous, we construct a multiple-choice human study (more details in Appendix A.2 ). Five participants replied to 100 multiple choice (MC) questions with counterfactual distractors and achieved 95.2% accuracy on average.
blocks.zh: 为了证实我们的合成编辑在概念上是毫不含糊的,我们构建了一个多选择的人类研究(详见附录A.2.)。 5名参与者用反事实分流器回答100个多选择(MC)问题,平均达到95.2%的精度.

blocks.en: Under the analogous MC-style forced-choice diagnostic, however, the best VLM judge reaches only 71.5% (Tab. 1 ). This gap suggests that model failures are unlikely to stem from ambiguous synthetic examples, but rather from limitations in the judges’ ability to discriminate between factual and counterfactual edit triplets.
blocks.zh: 然而,在类似的MC式强制选择诊断中,最佳的VLM法官仅占71.5%(第1段)。 这一差距表明,模型的失败不太可能来自模棱两可的合成实例,而是由于法官区分事实和反事实编辑三重性的能力受到限制。

blocks.en: 4.3 Correlation with human-preference benchmarks
blocks.zh: 4.3 与人的优先基准的相关性

blocks.en: Here, we ask whether performance on EditJudge-Bench agrees with existing human-preference edit benchmarks. For GenAI-Bench [ 12 ] and EditRewardBench [ 46 ] , we measure whether each judge assigns a higher score to the human-preferred candidate, and compare this preference accuracy with the judge’s macro edit-type AUROC on EditJudge-Bench . Across 11 judge configurations, macro AUROC on EditJudge-Bench is strongly Spearman rank-correlated with GenAI-Bench ( ρ = 0.95 \rho=0.95 ) and EditRewardBench ( ρ = 0.71 \rho=0.71 ). As a reference point, the two human-preference benchmarks correlate with each other at ρ = 0.83 \rho=0.83 . This suggests that EditJudge-Bench captures judge-level differences relevant to real-image preference evaluation, while offering controlled ground truth and edit-type-level diagnostics unavailable in preference-only datasets (per-judge results in Appendix A.1 ).
blocks.zh: 在这里,我们询问Edit-Judge-Bench上的表现是否同意现有的人优编辑基准. 对于GenAI-Bench [12] 和Edit Reward Bench [46],我们衡量每位法官是否为人所偏爱的候选人分配了更高的分数,并将这一偏好准确度与法官在Edit-Judge-Bench上的宏观编辑型AUROC进行比较. 在整个11个法官配置中,编辑法官-奔驰上的宏观AUROC与GenAI-奔驰( ^ 0.95\rho=0.95)和Edit Reward Bench( ^ 0.71\rho=0. 作为参考点,两个人类优先基准在 ^ 0.83\rho = 0.83 之间相互关联。 这表明Edit Judge-Bench捕捉与真实图像偏好评价相关的法官级别差异,同时提供可控地面真相和编辑类型级别的诊断,在只偏好数据集中找不到(附录A.1中的每个法官结果).

blocks.en: 4.4 Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.4 分析

blocks.en: Image placement. Prior VIE-score implementations use different multimodal prompt orderings across model providers. Images are placed before the text instructions for Gemini, but after the text for GPT models. We ablate this choice by evaluating both orderings for Gemini-2.5-flash and GPT-4.1-mini. As shown in Appendix A.3 , placing images after the instruction improves AUROC by up to 14.1 points (13.7 points for Gemini-2.5-flash and 14.1 points for GPT-4.1-mini). This shows that prompt formatting choices, often treated as implementation details, can materially change judge rankings and motivate fixing the prompt format across baselines.
blocks.zh: 图像布置. 以往的VIE分数执行使用不同模式供应商的多式即时订单。 图像被放在双子座的文本指令前,但放在GBT模型的文本后. 通过评估双子座2.5-闪电和GPT-4.1-mini的订单,我们放弃了这一选择。 如附录A.3所示,在指令后放出图像可提高AUROC最高14.1分(双子座-2.5-闪光分13.7分,GPT-4.1-mini分). 这表明,即时格式化的选择往往被视为执行细节,可实质性地改变法官的排名并激励确定跨基线的即时格式。

blocks.en: No-edit counterfactuals are the main failure mode. We first break down performance by counterfactual type (Fig. 5 a). Directional, wrong-object, and cross-type counterfactuals are all rejected above chance, but far from perfectly, with a median AUROC in the low-to-mid 70s. No-edit counterfactuals are substantially harder: the median AUROC is markedly lower and varies widely across judges, making “nothing changed” the most difficult counterfactual to reject. Splitting no-edit counterfactuals by edit type (Fig. 5 b) shows that this aggregate hides two distinct regimes. For removal and material edits, judges usually identify the change. For shape, rotation, and scale edits, the median AUROC falls well below chance, meaning judges systematically rate the no-edit instruction as more consistent with the image pair than the true edit. Camera, move, lighting, and articulation edits fall in between.
blocks.zh: 无编辑反相是主要故障模式. 我们首先按照反事实类型(图5 a)分解性能. 方向性,错误对象,和跨型反事实均被排斥在机会之上,但远非完美无缺,低至中相的70年代有中位AUROC. 无编辑的反事实要困难得多:AUROC的中位数明显较低,法官之间差异很大,使“没有改变”成为最难拒绝的反事实。 按编辑类型(图5b)分拆无编辑反事实显示,这个集合隐藏了两种不同的制度. 对于去除和材料编辑,法官通常会识别变化. 对于形状,旋转,和比例编辑,AUROC的中位数远远低于偶然性,意味着法官系统评价无编辑指令与图像对比比更符合真实编辑. 相机,移动,照明, 和发光的编辑 落在中间。

blocks.en: To test whether this blind spot depends on edit magnitude, we stratify factual/no-edit comparisons by ground-truth Blender parameter changes (Fig. 5 c). We observe a consistent salience effect where AUROC rises with edit magnitude across shape, scale, and articulation. Scale moves from well below chance to above chance as changes grow, while articulation crosses chance above roughly 20 ∘ 20^{\circ} of door rotation. Shape edits remain below chance even in the top quartile, suggesting geometric changes are difficult to perceive at any tested magnitude. Overall, the no-edit blind spot reflects a limitation of visual differencing under low salience rather than a fixed failure of the prompt.
blocks.zh: 为了测试这个盲点是否取决于编辑的大小,我们用地-真实 Blender 参数变化来划分事实/不编辑的比较(图5 c). 我们观察到一个一致的显著效应,即AUROC在形状、规模和表达上以编辑量上升。 随着变化的增长,规模从机会远远低于机会,升至机会高于机会,而表述则跨越了大约20~~20~Circ}的门旋转。 形状的编辑即使在最上方的四分位仍然低于概率,说明几何变化在任何测试规模下都难以察觉. 总体而言,"不编辑"盲点反映了视觉差异在低显性下的限制,而不是"快"的固定故障.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusions
blocks.zh: 5. 结论

blocks.en: We introduced EditJudge-Bench , a diagnostic benchmark of controlled image editing pairs to audit VLM-based judges against known ground truth. Auditing 25 judge configurations across zero-shot prompting, probabilistic scoring, and fine-tuned reward models reveals that current protocols are far less reliable than their adoption suggests. EditJudge-Bench also exposes failure modes, like weak open-ended visual differencing, that aggregate human-preference correlations miss. Despite using synthetic data, our judge rankings correlate strongly with real-image human preferences ( ρ \rho =0.95 with GenAI-Bench), showing that controlled audits capture real-world failures. Ultimately, we hope EditJudge-Bench encourages the field to report per-edit-type reliability, validate judges using no-edit and counterfactual pairs, and standardise multimodal prompt formatting.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Edit Judge-Bench,这是对照已知的地面真相对基于VLM的法官进行审计的可控图像编辑配对的诊断基准. 审计25名法官的配置 跨越零镜头的提示,概率评分, 和微调的奖励模式 显示,目前的协议 远不如它们的通过所暗示的可靠。 编辑Judge-Bench也暴露出失败模式,如弱可开的视觉差异等,而聚合的人类偏好关联缺失. 尽管使用了合成数据,我们法官的排名与真实形象的人类偏好(与GenAI-Bench的\rho=0.95)有着很强的关联,表明受控制的审计记录了真实世界的失败. 归根结底,我们希望编辑法官-本奇鼓励实地报告每版的可靠性,使用不编辑和反事实对法官进行验证,并使多式快速格式标准化。

blocks.en: Limitations. EditJudge-Bench renders indoor scenes only, edits are produced by deterministic 3D interventions rather than by editing models, and binary verification is a targeted probe rather than a substitute for holistic edit-quality judgment. We elaborate more in Appendix E .
blocks.zh: 限制。 编辑Judge-Bench只制作室内场景,编辑由决定性3D干预产生,而不是由编辑模型产生,二进制校验是定向探针,而不是取代整体编辑质量判断. 我们详见附录E。

blocks.en: A.1 Alignment with Human Preference Benchmarks
blocks.zh: A.1 符合人类优先基准

blocks.en: Because EditJudge-Bench relies on controlled, synthetic image-instruction pairs to isolate factual editing errors, a natural question is whether performance on our benchmark transfers to real-world evaluation. To test this, we evaluate a shared set of judge configurations across EditJudge-Bench and two real-image human preference datasets: GenAI-Bench [ 12 ] and EditRewardBench [ 46 ] . Rather than positioning EditJudge-Bench as a replacement for open-ended preference benchmarks, this analysis tests whether the failure modes surfaced by controlled factual audits also govern how well judges align with human preferences on real images.
blocks.zh: 由于Edit Judge-Bench依赖于可控的,合成的图像指令对来隔离事实编辑错误,一个自然的问题就是我们的基准传输到现实世界的评价上的性能. 为了测试这一点,我们评价了Edit-Judge-Bench和两个真人形象偏好数据集共用的一套法官配置: GenAI-Bench [12] (英语). Edit Reward Bench [46]. 这一分析不是将Edit-Judge-Bench定位为无限期优惠基准的替代,而是检验了受控事实审计中出现的失败模式是否也决定了法官与人类对真实图像的偏好是否一致。

blocks.en: While EditJudge-Bench uses counterfactual pairs to evaluate strict factual verification (measured via overall AUROC), GenAI-Bench and EditRewardBench capture pairwise human preferences between candidate edits generated from the same real source image and prompt. On these preference datasets, we compute pairwise accuracy: a judge is scored as correct if they assign a higher score to the human-preferred edit, receive half credit for ties, and human-tied pairs are excluded. For EditRewardBench, we evaluate agreement against the overall preference score. We report the metrics in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: Edit Judge-Bench使用反事实对子来评价严格的事实验证(通过整体AUROC衡量),GenAI-Bench和Edit Reward Bench在从同一个真实源图像生成的候选编辑和即时的编辑之间按照双人偏好进行捕获. 在这些偏好数据集上,我们计算成对精度:如果法官为人所偏爱的编辑分配了更高的分数,则评分为正确分数,领分为分数的一半,而人所偏爱的一对则被排除在外. 对于Edition Reward Bench,我们比照总的优惠分来评价协议. 我们报告表3中的衡量标准。

blocks.en: To compare judge performance across different metrics and scales, we compute Spearman’s rank correlation ( ρ \rho ) across all matched judge configurations (Table 4 ). Despite using purely synthetic data, judge rankings on EditJudge-Bench correlate strongly with both real-image preference benchmarks ( ρ = 0.95 \rho=0.95 and ρ = 0.71 \rho=0.71 ). This demonstrates that controlled factual verification effectively captures core capabilities required for real-world human preference alignment.

blocks.en: A.2 Human Validation - Multiple Choice
blocks.zh: A.2 人类验证 -- -- 多重选择

blocks.en: Because ground-truth labels in EditJudge-Bench are determined programmatically from Blender rendering parameters, human annotation is not required to construct the dataset. Instead, we conduct a human study to verify that our synthetic edits and textual instructions are perceptually unambiguous, establishing a human performance ceiling for our multiple-choice diagnostic (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 由于Edit-Judge-Bench中的地真相标签是按程序从Blender渲染参数中确定的,因此不需要人为注释来构建数据集. 相反,我们开展了一项人类研究,以核实我们的合成编辑和文字指示在概念上是毫不含糊的,为我们的多选择诊断确定了人类性能上限(表1)。

blocks.en: Using the interface shown in Fig. 6 , participants were presented with a source/edited image pair alongside one ground-truth instruction and a number of counterfactual distractors (spanning wrong-object, directional, cross-edit-type, and no-edit alternatives). To facilitate fine-grained visual comparison, participants could toggle back and forth between the Before and After views in place by clicking the image or pressing the spacebar before locking in the description that best matched the observed change.
blocks.zh: 利用图6所示界面,向与会者介绍了一个源/编辑成像对,并附有一个地面真实指示和若干反事实分辨器(扩展出错误对象、取向、跨编辑类型和无编辑替代方法)。 为了便于进行精细的视觉比较,与会者可以点击图像或按下空间栏,然后锁定最符合观察到的变化的描述,从而在“前后”视图之间进行前后切换。

blocks.en: Five participants each evaluated 100 randomly sampled instances, achieving an average accuracy of 95.2%. This near-ceiling performance confirms that the rendered edits are visually clear and unambiguously described. Moreover, it highlights a stark capability gap: while the task is easy for humans (95.2%), the strongest VLM judge reaches only 71.5% accuracy on the same forced-choice setup (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 每名参与者评估100起随机抽样案例,平均准确度达到95.2%。 这一接近天花板的性能证实,所提供的编辑是清晰而清晰地描述的。 此外,它凸显出一个显著的能力差距:虽然这项任务对人类来说是容易的(95.2%),但最强的VLM裁判员在同一强制选择设置上只达到71.5%的精确度(表1)。

blocks.en: Figure 6: Human validation interface. Participants toggled between the source and edited image and selected the instruction that correctly described the observed edit from candidate descriptions. The options included one factual instruction and multiple counterfactual distractors.
blocks.zh: 图6:人类验证界面. 参与者从源和被编辑的图像之间切换,并从候选描述中选择正确描述所观察到的编辑的指令. 这些选项包括一个事实指示和多个反事实分心器。

blocks.en: In addition to AUROC, we evaluate a stricter within-example ranking diagnostic. For each before/after pair, we treat the factual instruction and its associated counterfactual instructions as a multiple-choice candidate set. Because several score-based judges produce ties, we report accuracy that gives 1 / k 1/k credit when the factual instruction ties for first among k k top-scoring candidates.
blocks.zh: 除了AUROC外,我们评价更严格的内部排名诊断. 对于每一对前后,我们将事实指示及其相关的反事实指示作为多选择的候选组合. 由于几位基于分数的评委产生联系,我们报告准确性,当对K最高分候选人进行事实指导时,准确性为1/k1/k。

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that this forced-choice diagnostic is substantially harder than AUROC. Even strong AUROC models often fail to select the factual instruction uniquely, especially when their scoring template produces coarse discrete scores: Kris with Gemma-4-31B reaches 72.9 AUROC but only 46.4% MC accuracy, as its 1–5 scores often tie the factual instruction with distractors. AUROC thus captures aggregate positive–negative separability, while MC-style accuracy exposes whether a judge can make a clean per-example decision among matched distractors.
blocks.zh: 表1显示,这种强制选择诊断比AUROC困难得多。 即使很强的AUROC模型也往往无法单独选择实事求是的指令,特别是当它们的分数模板产生粗糙的离散分数时: Kris与Gemma-4-31B的比分达到72.9 AUROC,但只有46.4%的MC精度,因为其1-5分数往往将事实指示与分心器相挂钩. AUROC因此捕捉到集合正-负分离性,而MC式的精确性则暴露出法官是否能够在相匹配的分心者中作出干净的逐个实例决定.

blocks.en: A.3 Image Placement Ablation
blocks.zh: A.3 图像放置偏差

blocks.en: Prior zero-shot edit-evaluation templates do not always specify the ordering of image and text tokens. In the official VIE-score implementation, we observed that Gemini prompts place the source and edited images before the textual instruction, whereas GPT prompts place the images after the text. We therefore evaluate both orderings while keeping the scoring template, image pairs, candidate instructions, and parsing code fixed.
blocks.zh: 先前的零发编辑评价模板并不总是指定图像和文本符的顺序. 在官方的VIE分数执行中,我们观察到双子座提示将源和编辑的图像放入文本指令之前,而GPT提示将图像放入文本之后. 因此,我们评价两个订单,同时保留评分模板、图像对等、候选指令和解析代码。

blocks.en: Table 5 shows that this prompt-ordering choice has a large effect on measured judge performance. For Gemini-2.5-flash, moving the images after the text improves overall AUROC from 59.1 to 72.8. For GPT-4.1-mini, the same change improves AUROC from 53.3 to 67.4. The gains are broad across edit categories, especially for removal, material, movement, and rotation. These results indicate that multimodal prompt formatting is a consequential part of the evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 表5显示,这种即时排序的选择对衡量法官的业绩有很大影响。 对于双子座-2.5-闪光,在文本后移动图像会改善整个AUROC,从59.1到72.8. 对GPT-4.1-mini来说,同样的变化使AUROC从53.3提高到67.4. 各编辑类别的收益相去甚远,特别是在去除、材料、移动和轮换方面。 这些结果表明,多式联运即时格式化是评价协议的必然组成部分。

blocks.en: Table 5: The impact of image placement on zero-shot judge performance using VIE-score. Placing images after the instructional text substantially improves AUROC for both models.
blocks.zh: 表5:使用VIE分数进行图像投放对零镜头裁判员性能的影响. 将图像放入指令文本之后,大大改进了两个模型的AUROC。

blocks.en: Appendix B Dataset Generation Details
blocks.zh: 附录B 数据集生成细节

blocks.en: We generate before/after image pairs by programmatically manipulating 3D indoor scenes produced by Infinigen [ 37 ] . Each scene is a .blend file containing a procedurally generated indoor environment with physically plausible object placement, materials, and lighting. Our pipeline has two decoupled phases. In the sampling phase, we sample valid views and edit parameters using rejection sampling. In the rendering phase, we render the resulting source and edited images with Blender’s ray-tracing engine. This decoupling lets us validate edits in 3D before launching render jobs.
blocks.zh: 我们通过程序上操纵由Infinigen制作的 三维室内场景来生成图像前后的对 [37]. 每个场景是一个.blend文件,包含一个程序生成的室内环境,并带有物理上可信的物体放置,材料和照明. 我们的管道有两个脱钩阶段。 在采样阶段,我们使用拒绝采样对有效视图进行抽样并编辑参数. 在渲染阶段,我们用 Blender 的射线追踪引擎来渲染产生的源和编辑图像。 这种脱钩让我们在启动任务前以 3D 验证编辑 。

blocks.en: Each scene is parsed into a structured scene graph. Every object has a record containing its Blender mesh name, factory type, parent relation (floor, wall, or object), spatial relationships, and child objects. To increase object diversity, we deduplicate by object factory type when selecting edit targets, retaining at most one instance per factory class within a scene.
blocks.zh: 每个场景被分解成结构化的场景图. 每个物体都有记录,其中包含 Blender mesh名称、工厂类型、父母关系(地板、墙壁或物体)、空间关系和儿童物体。 为了增加对象多样性,我们在选择编辑目标时会按对象工厂类型进行调试,最多保留一个场景内每个工厂类的一个实例.

blocks.en: For each candidate target object, we attempt to place a virtual camera on a cylinder centred at the object’s geometric centroid. The camera distance is sampled as d ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( d min , d max ) d\sim\mathcal{U}(d_{\min},d_{\max}) , the azimuth is sampled within ± 45 ∘ \pm 45^{\circ} of the object’s forward-facing direction, and the height is sampled as z ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( z min , z max ) z\sim\mathcal{U}(z_{\min},z_{\max}) . The camera is constrained to look at the target object. A view is accepted only if the target visibility exceeds τ vis = 0.2 \tau_{\mathrm{vis}}=0.2 , estimated by face-level ray casting with frustum culling, backface culling, and occlusion checks.
blocks.zh: 对于每个候选目标物体,我们试图将一个虚拟相机放入以物体几何心形为中心的圆柱上. 相机相距被取样为d ∼ U ⁡ (d min, d max) d\sim\ mathcal{U} (d _{\ (d _{\ min}, d _{\max}),相机相距被取样为 ± 45 ∘ (pm 45^{\circ}) 对象前向方向的相距被取样为 z U ⁡ (z min, z max}) 相距被取样为 z (z  min min, z max}) . 相机受限观察目标物体. 只有在目标能见度超过 = 0.2\tau_{\mathrm{ vis 0.2 时,才接受视图,按面部射线铸造,并用花纹取出,背面取出取出取出取出,并进行取出检查。

blocks.en: Within each accepted view, we identify visible objects using both a face-sampling visibility test and a Monte Carlo pixel-area test. Objects must pass a visibility threshold of at least 0.3 0.3 and occupy at least 0.04 0.04 of the sampled image area. We then sample edits over all enabled edit types, resetting the scene to its original state between edits so that each before/after pair is independent.
blocks.zh: 在每一个被接受的视图中,我们通过面相抽样能见度测试和蒙特卡洛像素区域测试来识别可见物体. 物体必须至少通过0.3 0.3的能见度阈值,并至少占据被采样图像区域的0.04 0.04. 然后我们对所有已启用的编辑类型进行抽样编辑,在编辑之间将场景重置为其原始状态,以使每对前/后都是独立的。

blocks.en: Spatial and shape-changing edits are validated with rejection sampling. We use collision checks to reject edits that cause interpenetration, visibility checks to ensure that the edited object remains visible, and minimum-magnitude thresholds to ensure perceptibility. Collision tests use cached object geometry and bounding volumes to avoid repeatedly rebuilding the full scene during sampling.
blocks.zh: 空间和形状变化的编辑通过拒绝抽样验证。 我们使用碰撞检查来拒绝导致互通的编辑,能见度检查来保证被编辑对象保持可见,并使用最小放大阈值来保证可感知性. 碰撞测试使用缓存的物体几何并捆绑体积来避免在采样时反复重建整个场景.

blocks.en: B.1 Edit Types
blocks.zh: B.1 编辑类型

blocks.en: EditJudge-Bench contains nine benchmark edit categories: scale, removal/addition, material, movement, shape, rotation, articulation, lighting, and camera. Camera edits contain two subtypes, zoom and view, which are both reported under the camera category in the main experiments.
blocks.zh: 编辑Judge-Bench包含9个基准编辑类别:比例、去除/添加、材料、运动、形状、旋转、发音、照明和相机。 相机编辑包含两个子类型,即缩放和取景,两者都在主要实验的相机类别下被报告.

blocks.en: Scale. We apply a uniform scale factor s ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( 0.5 , 2.0 ) s\sim\mathcal{U}(0.5,2.0) to all axes. Edits that cause collisions or leave the object insufficiently visible are rejected. Wall-mounted objects are excluded.
blocks.zh: 规模。 我们对所有轴都采用统一的比例系数s ∼ U (0. 5, 2. 0) s\sim\ mathcal{ U} (0. 5, 2. 0) 。 导致碰撞或使物体不明显可见的编辑被否决。 墙载物体不包括在内。

blocks.en: We hide a prominently visible object with visibility at least 0.5 0.5 to produce removal edits. Addition edits are obtained by swapping the before and after images of a removal edit; all benchmark pairs use the removal direction.
blocks.zh: 我们隐藏一个能见度至少为0.5 0.5的明显可见物体来产生去除编辑. 添加编辑是通过互换去除编辑的图像前后获得的;所有基准对使用去除方向.

blocks.en: We sample a physically based rendering material from a curated texture library and apply it to the target object. Each material may include diffuse, normal, roughness, metallic, and displacement maps. For objects with semantically distinct material regions, such as appliance bodies, handles, or glass panels, we also support per-slot material replacement by modifying the object’s factory parameter dictionary and rebuilding the mesh.
blocks.zh: 我们从一个有纹理的图书库中 取出一个物理的渲染材料 并将其应用到目标物体上 每种材料可包括散射、正常、粗糙、金属和转移地图。 对于具有明显不同的物质区域的物品,如电器机构、手柄或玻璃板,我们也支持通过修改物体的工厂参数词典和重建网格来更换每层材料。

blocks.en: For a visible object with parent surface S S , we sample N = 200 N=200 candidate positions on S S by surface point sampling. A candidate is accepted only if the displacement is at least 0.3 0.3 m, the object does not collide with other scene geometry, and the object remains visible from the camera. Wall-mounted objects are reoriented to align with the new surface normal. Movement direction is computed relative to the camera view plane and quantised into eight compass directions.
blocks.zh: 对于具有母表面S S的可见物体,我们通过地表点取样在S S上对N = 200 N = 200个候选位置进行取样。 只有迁移至少为0.3 0.3米,物体与其他场景几何不相撞时,才接受候选,物体从相机上仍然可见. 墙架物体被重定向以配合新的平面正常. 运动方向相对于相机取景平面进行计算,并被量化为8个指南针方向.

blocks.en: Shape edits modify continuous procedural factory parameters, such as object width, height, depth, or chair back height. A new parameter value is sampled within an edit range extending beyond the default factory sampling range, and the relative change must exceed 5 % 5\% of the edit range. The edited object is rebuilt at its original world-space transform and checked for collisions. If the edited object has children, they are repositioned to maintain physical support when possible; children that still collide after repositioning are hidden.
blocks.zh: 形状编辑修改了连续的程序厂参数,如对象宽度,高度,深度,或椅回高. 在超出默认工厂采样范围的编辑范围内对一新参数值进行采样,相对变化必须超过编辑范围的5%-5%-%. 被编辑的对象在其最初的世界-空间变换被重建并检查相撞. 如果被编辑的对象有子,则在可能时会被重新定位以保持物理支持;被重新定位后仍会相撞的儿童被隐藏.

blocks.en: We rotate the target object about the vertical axis by α ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( − 160 ∘ , 160 ∘ ) \alpha\sim\mathcal{U}(-160^{\circ},160^{\circ}) with | α | ≥ 10 ∘ |\alpha|\geq 10^{\circ} . Rotations that cause collisions are rejected, with up to 50 resampling attempts. Wall-mounted objects are excluded.
blocks.zh: 我们用 α → U (- 160 ∘, 160 ∘) 来旋转关于垂直轴的目标对象。 导致相撞的旋转被拒绝,最多50次再生尝试. 墙载物体不包括在内。

blocks.en: Articulation edits modify joint parameters, such as oven or fridge door rotation. The object is rebuilt from its factory with the modified joint value. Since articulation may change the bounding box while the object body should remain fixed, we compute an origin correction from a reference mesh at the original parameter value and apply the corresponding offset to keep the body stationary.
blocks.zh: 外观编辑会修改联合参数,如烤箱或冰箱门旋转等. 物体从工厂重建出,具有被修改的联想值. 由于在物体体保持固定的同时,表达可能改变边框,因此我们按照原始参数值计算参考网点的源修正,并应用相应的抵消来保持物体的静止.

blocks.en: Camera edits include two subtypes. Zoom perturbs the focal length by Δ ​ f ∼ 𝒰 ⁡ ( ± 2 , ± 6 ) \Delta f\sim\mathcal{U}(\pm 2,\pm 6) mm. View re-places the camera on the viewing cylinder around the same target object, requiring a camera-position displacement between 0.3 0.3 m and 1.0 1.0 m.
blocks.zh: 相机编辑包括两个子类型. 将焦距缩放为 QQ f U (±2,±6)\Delta f\sim\mathcal{U} (\pm 2,\pm 6) mm. 取景将相机重新放置在取景筒上,围绕同一个目标物体,需要相机位置相机位移为0.3米至1.0米.

blocks.en: Lighting edits apply one of 10 named illumination presets, such as warm , sunset , or night . Each preset specifies RGB color and energy values that are applied to the point lights in the scene.
blocks.zh: 照明编辑应用了10个命名的照明预设之一,例如温暖,日出,或夜间. 每个预设都指定了适用于场景中点灯的RGB颜色和能量值.

blocks.en: Appendix E Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录E 限制

blocks.en: EditJudge-Bench uses synthetic indoor scenes rendered from procedurally generated Blender assets. This design provides exact ground truth over what changed, which is essential for auditing judge failures, but it also limits visual diversity relative to real image-editing benchmarks. Results on EditJudge-Bench should therefore be interpreted as diagnostic evidence about controlled edit verification, not as a complete substitute for evaluation on natural images.
blocks.zh: 编辑法官-奔驰使用由程序生成的Blender资产制成的合成室内场景. 这种设计为所改变的事物提供了准确的地心真理,这对于审计法官的失误至关重要,但也限制了视觉多样性相对于真实的图像编辑基准. 因此,编辑法官-Bench的成果应被解释为关于有控制的编辑核查的诊断证据,而不是完全取代对自然图像的评价。

blocks.en: The benchmark covers nine edit types: removal/addition, material, lighting, camera, movement, scale, shape, articulation, and rotation. These edits were chosen to cover common low-level and object-level transformations with controllable ground truth. However, they do not exhaust the space of real editing requests, especially complex semantic edits, identity-preserving edits, style transfer, text rendering, human-centric edits, and open-ended compositional changes.
blocks.zh: 基准涵盖9个编辑类型:去除/添加、材料、照明、相机、移动、尺度、形状、发音和旋转。 选择这些编辑是为了覆盖具有可控地真能的常见低等和对象级的转换. 然而,它们并没有耗尽真实编辑请求的空间,特别是复杂的语义编辑,身份保留编辑,风格转移,文本渲染,以人为中心的编辑,以及开放式的构成变化.

blocks.en: Our benchmark audits VLM-based judges by asking whether they assign higher scores to factual edit instructions than to counterfactual ones. It does not directly measure the quality of image-editing models, since the edited images are generated by a controlled synthetic pipeline rather than by arbitrary editing systems. The findings therefore speak to the reliability of automated evaluation protocols, not to the absolute quality of any image editor.
blocks.zh: 我们基于VLM的基准审计法官通过询问他们是否为事实编辑指示分配了比反事实指示更高的分数. 它不直接测量图像编辑模型的质量,因为被编辑的图像是由受控制的合成管道生成的,而不是任意的编辑系统. 因此,调查结果涉及自动评价协议的可靠性,而不是任何图像编辑器的绝对质量。

blocks.en: We find that small implementation choices, such as image-text ordering, can substantially affect judge performance. Consequently, reported numbers should be understood as properties of a model, prompt template, scoring rule, and preprocessing stack together. Future model releases or different inference settings may change absolute performance, although the diagnostic structure of the benchmark remains applicable.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,小的执行选择,如图像文本排序,会严重影响法官的业绩。 因此,报告的数字应被理解为模型的属性、即时模板、评分规则和预处理堆栈。 未来的模型释放或不同的推论设置可能会改变绝对性能,尽管基准的诊断结构仍然适用.

blocks.en: Counterfactual instructions are generated from templates and parameter perturbations. This makes failures interpretable, but it may not cover all linguistic variability found in natural user instructions. In particular, real instructions may be ambiguous, underspecified, conversational, or contain multiple simultaneous edit requests.
blocks.zh: 反事实指令来自模板和参数扰动. 这使得故障是可以解释的,但它可能无法涵盖在自然用户指令中发现的所有语言可变性. 特别是,真实的指示可能含混不清,不够明确,对话,或者包含多个同时编辑的请求.

blocks.en: We evaluate a broad set of recent VLM judges and scoring paradigms, including generative prompts, probabilistic scoring, reranking, and supervised judge models. However, the VLM landscape changes quickly, and proprietary model versions may change over time. Our results should be viewed as an audit of the evaluated systems and protocols rather than a permanent ranking of all possible judges.
blocks.zh: 我们评价一系列近期的VLM评委和评分范式,包括基因激励、概率评分、重排和受监督的法官模型。 然而,VLM的地貌变化很快,专有模型版本可能会随时间而变化. 我们的结果应被视为对所评价的制度和程序的审计,而不是对所有可能的法官的永久排名。

blocks.en: Recent benchmarks use pairwise VLM comparisons over pointwise scoring [ 21 , 13 ] . We audit pointwise scoring to match our evaluated judges and benchmarks (VIEScore, EditScore, EditReward, ImgEdit-Judge, GEdit-Bench), leaving it open whether pairwise gains hold against ground truth rather than human preference. As a proxy, EditJudge-Bench ’s MC accuracy (Tab. 1 ) uses pointwise scores to rank factual instructions against matched counterfactuals, where the best open (60.8%) and overall (71.5%) judges trail humans (95.2%). Extending our evaluation to image-side pairwise evaluation is left to future work.
blocks.zh: 最近的基准使用双向VLM比对出分 [21, 13]. 我们的审计点评是为了与我们评价的法官与基准(VIEScore、EditScore、Edit Reward、ImgEdit-Judge、Gedit-Bench)相匹配,而不论双向收益是否与基本真理而不是人类的偏好相抗衡,都留有余地。 作为代名词,Edit-Judge Bench的MC精度(Tab. 1)使用点分法将事实指示与对应的反事实进行排序,其中最佳公开度(60.8%)和总体(71.5%)法官跟踪人类(95.2%)。 将我们的评价扩大到图像侧对等评价,留给今后的工作。

blocks.en: Appendix F Benchmark Card
blocks.zh: 附录F 纸牌

blocks.en: EditJudge-Bench is designed to audit VLM-based image-editing judges under controlled ground truth. The benchmark targets factual edit verification: given a source image, an edited image, and an instruction, a judge should assign higher scores to factual instructions than to counterfactual instructions. It is not intended to evaluate the perceptual quality or user preference of image-editing models in the wild.
blocks.zh: 编辑法官-Bench旨在对基于VLM的图像编辑法官进行受控地面真相的审计. 基准针对事实编辑验证:给予源图像,被编辑的图像,以及指令,法官应给事实指示分配比反事实指示更高的分数. 它无意评价野外图像编辑模型的认知质量或用户偏好.

blocks.en: EditJudge-Bench contains 1,382 synthetic before/after edit pairs rendered in Blender across 1,000 procedurally generated indoor scenes. Edits span nine edit types: removal/addition, material, lighting, camera, movement, scale, shape, articulation, and rotation. Each edit pair is associated with factual and counterfactual text instructions, including directional, wrong-object, cross-edit-type, and no-edit counterfactuals.
blocks.zh: 编辑法官-本奇包含1 382个在编辑Blender制成的一对之前/之后合成的一对,覆盖了1 000个程序生成的室内场景。 编辑跨越了9个编辑类型:去除/添加、材料、照明、相机、运动、规模、形状、发音和旋转。 每个编辑对与事实和反事实的文本指令相关,包括方向性,错误对象,交叉编辑类型,和无编辑反事实.

blocks.en: Because each scene is generated procedurally, the benchmark stores the exact Blender parameters before and after each edit. These include object position 𝐱 \mathbf{x} , rotation 𝐫 \mathbf{r} , scale 𝐬 \mathbf{s} , procedural shape parameter θ \theta , articulation parameter ψ \psi , lighting state ℓ \ell , object visibility v v , material assignment m m , and camera state 𝒞 \mathcal{C} . These parameters enable edit-type-level analysis and salience-based stratification of judge failures.
blocks.zh: 由于每个场景都是通过程序生成的,因此基准在每次编辑前后存储精确的Blender参数. 包括对象位置 x\ mathbf{x},旋转 r\ mathbf{r}, 缩放 s\ mathbf{s}, 程序形状参数\\theta , 表达参数\\ psi, 照明状态 l\ell, 对象能见度 v, 物质指派 m, 相机状态 C\ mathcal{C} 。 这些参数可以进行编辑类型级分析,并以突出位置为基础对法官失误进行分层.

blocks.en: Scenes are sampled from a procedural 3D pipeline and rendered with Blender. For each target object, valid views and edits are sampled using rejection criteria that enforce visibility, collision-free geometry, physical plausibility, and minimum perceptibility. Source and edited images are rendered from the resulting scene states. Factual instructions are generated from the known edit parameters, and counterfactual instructions are generated by perturbing the direction, target object, edit type, or no-edit hypothesis.
blocks.zh: 场景取自一个3D程序管道的样本,并与Blender一起提供. 对于每个目标对象,有效视图和编辑都使用强制可见度,无相撞几何,物理可信度,最小能见度的拒绝标准进行抽样. 源头和被编辑的图像都取自由此产生的场景状态。 事实指令由已知的编辑参数生成,反事实指令由扰动方向,目标对象,编辑类型,或无编辑假说生成.

blocks.en: Although the structural ground truth is guaranteed by construction, we validate perceptual clarity with a multiple-choice human study. Participants toggle between source and edited images and select the matching factual instruction. On 100 representative edit triplets, five participants achieved 100%, 98%, 97%, 92%, and 89% accuracy, suggesting that the rendered edits are perceptually unambiguous to humans.
blocks.zh: 虽然结构地心真理通过建筑得到保证,但我们通过多种选择的人类研究验证了知觉清晰度. 参与者在源和编辑的图像之间切换,并选择匹配的事实指令. 在100个具有代表性的编辑三重奏上,有5个参与者实现了100%,98%,97%,92%,以及89%的准确度,这表明所提供的编辑对人类来说是概念上毫不含糊的.

blocks.en: EditJudge-Bench is intended for evaluating and auditing VLM-as-a-judge systems, prompt templates, scoring rules, and edit-verification metrics. It is especially suited for diagnosing systematic judge failures by edit type, counterfactual type, and controlled edit magnitude.
blocks.zh: 编辑法官-本奇用于评价和审计VLM-as-a-judge系统、即时模板、评分规则和编辑-核查衡量标准。 它特别适合通过编辑类型,反事实类型,以及可控编辑量来诊断系统性判断失败.

blocks.en: The benchmark should not be interpreted as a complete measure of real-world image-editing quality, aesthetic preference, or generative model usefulness. Since all images are synthetic indoor scenes, results may not fully transfer to natural photographs, artistic images, human faces, or open-ended real user edits.
blocks.zh: 基准不应被解释为对现实世界图像编辑质量、审美偏好或基因模型有用性的全面衡量。 由于所有图像都是人工合成的室内场景,结果可能不会完全转移到自然相片,艺术相片,人相,或开放式真实用户编辑.

blocks.en: The benchmark trades real-image diversity for controlled ground truth. It covers a fixed set of edit types and procedural scene distributions, and may underrepresent semantic, stylistic, or object categories common in real editing tasks. VLM behavior may also depend on prompt formatting, model version, and image preprocessing choices.
blocks.zh: 基准用真实的图像多样性来换取控制的地面真理。 它涵盖了一套固定的编辑类型和程序的场景分布,并可能不代表语义,语义,或现实编辑任务中常见的对象类别. VLM行为还可能依赖于即时格式化,模型版本,以及图像预处理选择.

blocks.en: The benchmark is synthetically generated and does not contain real personal data. However, automated judge scores may be misused as proxies for human preference or image quality. We therefore recommend using EditJudge-Bench as a diagnostic audit tool rather than as a standalone replacement for human evaluation.
blocks.zh: 该基准是合成生成的,并不包含真实的个人数据. 然而,自动裁判分数可能被滥用,作为人类偏好或图像质量的代名词. 因此,我们建议使用Edit Judge-Bench作为诊断性审计工具,而不是单独取代人力评价。

blocks.en: The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/JensParslov/EditJudge-Bench (CC BY-NC 4.0) and the code at https://github.com/JensPars/EditJudge-Bench (MIT). The release includes the rendered images, instruction triplets, saved ground-truth parameters, evaluation scripts, and Croissant metadata. We version updates with git tags and document schema changes.
blocks.zh: 数据集见https://huggingface.co/datasets/JensParslov/EditJudge-Bench(CC BY-NC 4.0)和代码见https://github.com/JensPars/EditJudge-Bench(麻省理工学院)。 发布内容包括已渲染的图像、指示三进制、已保存的地面真实参数、评价脚本和克罗桑元数据。 我们用 git 标签和文档计划更改来更新 。

blocks.en: F.1 Compute Resources
blocks.zh: F.1 计算资源

blocks.en: Dataset generation consists of CPU-side edit sampling followed by Blender rendering. Edit sampling parses each Infinigen scene, samples candidate edits, and applies rejection sampling for visibility, collision, and validity constraints. Rendering was performed with Blender’s Cycles renderer using GPU workers, primarily NVIDIA L40S GPUs, at 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 resolution. Rendering is embarrassingly parallel across scenes and edit candidates. The released benchmark contains all 1,500 rendered edit pairs (1,382 curated) as lossless 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 PNG renders.
blocks.zh: 数据集生成由CPU-侧编辑采样,再由Blender渲染. 编辑样本解析每个Infinigen场景,样本候选编辑,并对能见度、相撞和有效性限制应用拒绝取样。 Blender的循环渲染器使用GPU工人进行渲染,主要是NVIDIA L40S GPU,在1920×1080 1920\times 1080分辨率. 渲染令人尴尬的平行跨场景和编辑候选人. 发布的基准中包含所有1500个制成的编辑对(1,382个编导),作为无损失的1920×1080 1920\times 1080 PNG makes.

blocks.en: Open-weight VLM judges were served with vLLM on a single NVIDIA H100 GPU per run. Where official quantized checkpoints were available, we used the corresponding quantized variants, listed in our released code. We enabled vLLM prefix caching, which is useful in our setting because candidate instructions for the same before/after pair share the same image inputs and much of the prompt prefix. This substantially reduces repeated prefill computation across the positive and counterfactual instructions for each image pair.
blocks.zh: 公开量级的VLM评委每跑一次为VLLM服务,单次为NVIDIA H100 GPU. 在有官方量化检查站的地方,我们使用了相应的量化变体,列在我们公布的代码中。 我们启用了 vLLM 前缀 框 , 在我们的设置中有用, 因为相同对齐前/ 之后的候选指令 共享相同的图像输入和大部分的提示前缀 。 这大大减少了每对图像的正反事实指令重复的预填计算。

blocks.en: Proprietary models were evaluated through hosted APIs rather than local GPU inference. Their runtime depends on provider-side batching, rate limits, and response length. After prediction files are produced, all metric computation is lightweight: AUROC aggregation, per-counterfactual-type breakdowns, salience stratification, MC-style accuracy, and bridge-analysis statistics run on CPU in minutes and require only a few GB of memory. The released evaluation code reproduces these aggregate metrics from saved prediction files without rerunning VLM inference or Blender rendering.
blocks.zh: 通过托管的API而不是本地GPU推论来评价自有模式. 它们的运行时间取决于提供者-侧分批,速率限制和响应长度. 制作出预测文件后,所有度量计算都是轻量级的: AUROC 汇总,每倒数型分解,突出分层,MC式精度,和桥接分析统计在几分钟后运行在CPU上,只需要几GB的内存. 所发布的评价代码在不重运行VLM推论或Blender渲染的情况下从被保存的预测文件中复制出这些聚合度量.
